findings.question: What happens when the model calculation disagrees?

pair.condition: Source checks pass, but the model calculates a different total
pair.quote:
| Status | Meaning | Promotion | CLI exit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `verified` | All source checks pass; the model calculation agrees when enabled | Yes | 0 |
| `disputed` | A deterministic evidence or arithmetic check failed | No | 2 |
| `needs_review` | Source checks pass, but the model calculates a different total | No | 3 |

pair.condition: Source checks pass, but the model calculates a different total

scope: All supported_answer query records; policy identified by route, question slot or extraction events. Not-found findings have no accepted pair; historical source_excerpt records were not accepted answers. Stored snapshots used, no original files or model calls.
